# llms.txt — machine-readable project summary for LLM discovery
# GitHub Repo Beautifier — Hermes skill for premium README creation
# Version: 2.0.0 | License: MIT | Author: Azamat Safarov

Project: GitHub Repo Beautifier
Type: Hermes Agent Skill
Purpose: Transform GitHub READMEs into premium product pages
License: MIT
Repository: https://github.com/AzamatSafarov/github-repo-beautifier
Install URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AzamatSafarov/github-repo-beautifier/main/SKILL.md

Core Function:
- Inspects existing README and project structure
- Determines project type (web app / library / tool / visualization)
- Selects format: Hero Banner (full assets) or Fast ASCII (text-only)
- Generates SVG visual assets: logo mark, hero banner, architecture flow
- Writes product-oriented copy with concrete numbers and anti-slop rules
- Structures 14-section hierarchy with emoji-led headings
- Verifies GitHub rendering before finalizing

Two Formats:
1. Hero Banner Style: centered mark, for-the-badge shields, wide SVG hero, 14 sections, architecture diagram
2. Fast ASCII Style: ASCII banner, flat-square shields, emoji tree, status table

Visual Asset Specs:
- Logo mark: SVG, 92x92px, dark gradient (#0f0f1a → #1a1a2e)
- Hero banner: SVG/PNG, ~1200x400px, dark-mode friendly
- Architecture flow: SVG, ~1000x280px, pipeline diagram
- Social preview: PNG, 1280x640px

Section Structure (14 sections):
Hero Block → Framing → Concept → Features → Quick Start → Core Mechanism → Package/Structure → At a Glance → Tech Stack → Workflow → What Improves → Example Output → Quality Checks → Roadmap → Contributing → License

Anti-Slop Rules:
- Rotate opening phrases (Готово, Сделано, Запушено, В продакшене)
- Avoid: "Как вы можете видеть", "Важно отметить", "Не забудьте"
- Concrete numbers: "16 файлов, 6936 строк" not "много изменений"
- Vary status emoji: ✅ 🟢 📦 🚀 🎯

Real Examples:
- hermes-optimizer: Hero Banner format, provider-agnostic skill
- rag-shchedrovitsky: Hero Banner format, RAG bot for Shchedrovitsky
- creative-system: Fast ASCII format, autoposting system

Skills: Markdown, YAML, SVG generation, Shields.io badges, GitHub rendering, copywriting
Dependencies: None (pure Markdown skill)
